If $R_B$ denotes the resistance of the brass wire and $R_S$ denotes the resistance of the silver wire, which of the following is true?"
Statement: The resistance of a wire is determined by the formula $R = \rho \frac{L}{A}$. Resistance is inversely proportional to area ($A \propto d^2$). Brasses area is 16 times larger, and resistivity is 5 times higher. Thus $R_B = (5 \rho_S L) / (16 A_S) = \frac{5}{16} R_S$.
